result.summary:
Ran scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8, source: nproc) twice after `mix deps.get` (lua 1.0.2 already resolved/unchanged) and a clean `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (0 warnings). Run 1: 2057 tests, 5 properties, 3 failures (2059/2062 passed). Run 2: 2057 tests, 5 properties, 2 failures (2060/2062 passed). REQ-151's own tests (test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs + test/letflow/engine/lua_script_audit_test.exs) pass cleanly standalone: 'Result: 46 passed'. Docker CLI/daemon was unusable this session (a stray hung dockerd shared with unrelated host services -- penpot, immich -- refused both `docker compose up -d` and `sudo docker ps`, and a `systemctl restart docker` attempt also failed); did not force-kill the shared daemon. Worked around by confirming via `ss -tlnp` that this project's Postgres containers were already up and listening on the .env-configured port (LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5463, resolved by config/db_port.exs), so Ecto could reach the DB without the docker CLI.

All 3 distinct failures observed across both runs attributed structurally as pre-existing/unrelated to this run's own diff, per core-directives.md's 'Failure Attribution Is Structural, Never By Count-Matching':

F1/F2 (test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs A5 and A4a, both seen in run1 and run2 partition 1): not-in-diff (this branch's diff touches only lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex, its tests, lib/letflow/design/req151-lua-sandbox.md, mix.exs/mix.lock's lua dep, and handoff/spec files -- no docs/status file) AND reproduced-at-merge-base (checked out a worktree at `git merge-base main HEAD` = 8c331b6621becb11814a0cc234411527e2e21db5, ran the same two tests there, got the identical failure: an undeclared ISS-0332 vocabulary entry at docs/status/requirement_status.v4.yaml:1122).

F3 (test/letflow/api/context_test.exs 'scoped_repo_opts/1 is 1-arity', seen once in run1 partition 6, not in run2 at all): not-in-diff (neither test/letflow/api/context_test.exs nor lib/letflow/api/context.ex appear in this branch's diff). Re-ran that file standalone 9 times on this branch (default random seed): failed once, passed 8 times; with a fixed seed it passed 5/5. Ran the same file 5 times in the merge-base worktree: passed 5/5. Confirmed intermittent/order-dependent flakiness unrelated to this run's diff, not a regression this run introduced -- no plausible code path from the re-added {:lua, "~> 1.0"} dependency (or anything else in this diff) reaches Letflow.Api.Context's function_exported?/3 check.

No failure in either run traces to this run's own implementation (lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex or its tests) or to the re-added lua dependency. Both pre-existing issues (F1/F2's docs-status vocabulary drift, F3's context_test.exs flakiness) are reported to ORCH below for filing -- not fixed on this branch, out of REQ-151's scope.
